scientific_result.reason: The official documentary partition and the currently exposed ANA IDEP Unidades Hidrográficas service could not be reconciled to a unique vector feature for Jicamarca or Canto Grande. No polygon is admissible until an official vector source or an independently reproducible hydrologic delineation with a defensible control point is available.

official_live_service_probe.interpretation: The exposed service layers do not reproduce either documentary Rímac partition closely enough to identify Jicamarca/Canto Grande by exact code, name or preregistered area. Treating unrelated features as substitutes is forbidden.

Independently resolve Río Seco and Canto Grande–Media Luna from defensible channel/control-point evidence without deriving them from a Jicamarca parent polygon.
Keep Huaycoloro on the existing chosica_huaycoloro reference and do not duplicate its geometry.
forbidden: accept an unrelated ANA feature because its area is similar
silently map the 2010 code partition onto the 2019 partition
use documentary PDF map outlines as vector geometry
use either documentary parent partition as a local activation unit
union Jicamarca and Canto Grande into a synthetic activation polygon
derive Río Seco, Huaycoloro, Media Luna or named-channel child geometry from a parent boundary
infer discharge, travel time, attenuation, hydraulic capacity or receiver overflow
treat any parent polygon as an event footprint, risk class or alert layer
